sections.shortTitle: Sindh Martial Law Order No 227 Repeal Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT X OF 1989
ACT X OF 1989
SINDH (MARTIAL LAW
ORDER NO. 227) REPEAL ACT, 1989
An Act to repeal
Martial Law Order No. 227 issued by Martial Law Administrator Zone, C
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 3rd June, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis-B-7/89, dated
3-6-1989.--The Sindh (Martial Law Order No.227) Repeal Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 12th April, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th May, 1989 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This act may be called the Sindh (Martial Law Order
No.227) Repeal Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
